I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so they could already see the message.

- **Account link is my inference:** Tobias's message says "the dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks by name. I connected the two using a January 2026 note in GBrain, which calls Marrow Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it was changing hands on Jan 5, 2026.
- **No status update:** I didn't find any later update on the ticket. I told Pree to check with Tobias before the call if they need the latest.
- **No account files:** I found no Marrow Fieldworks files on the shared drive, so I had nothing to cross-check the ticket against.
